# HER NEXT MISSION

> A 501(c)(3) nonprofit (in formation) serving female Veterans and first responders transitioning out of service. Coaching, community, and clarity for the next mission.

Founder: SMSgt Krystalore Crews, USAF (Ret.) — served 22 years, retired 2024.

## Programs

- /programs.html — six entry points (1:1 coaching, bootcamps, retreats, Summit, podcast sponsorships, grants)

## Crisis

If you are in crisis, dial 988 and press 1 for the Veterans Crisis Line, text 838255, or chat at https://www.veteranscrisisline.net. 24/7, free, confidential.
